review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in weapon-census.json. MEASURED: every wep_ record of ZBD/zrdr.zbd weapons.zrd (48: fifteen ROCKET-flagged, thirty-one CANNON machine/turret guns, the cannonball wep_28) through cs_content::ordnance::read_original_weapon_census, classified by the stated key rules (TORPEDO, LOCK_ON, an effect flag, IMPACT_PROXIMITY/DETONATION_DISTANCE, ROCKET) onto DeclaredOrdnanceFamily — the content-side counterpart of cs_sim::weapons::ordnance::OrdnanceFamily, pinned variant-for-variant on the test-only edge — with thirty-two records recorded as named limitations (t452_01.limit.<record>) and the fifteen-versus-eleven ROCKET/selectable-type gap recorded as rocket_type_count_mismatch. The census also found the glidebomb wep_25: a LOCK_ON record with no ROCKET flag the rocket-only reader structurally cannot see. NOT CLAIMED: original-run behavior (retail is read access, no agent ran the original); the classification is what the keys state, not what the records do. The claim is implemented: this awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
